claim_boundary: A signaling-dimension-four branch is proved by the saved exact rational separator. A signaling-dimension-three branch additionally requires the independent verifier to confirm every generated class, exact filter and saved feasible distribution.

support_reduction.normalization: Choose one support vertex and flip coordinates so it is the all-minus vertex; row permutations are coordinate permutations and right-part permutations relabel the other support vertices.
support_reduction.sizes_at_most_five: The seed Theorem 2.2 construction uses a coordinate facet containing at most floor(m/2)<=2 support points, hence subsets of size at most three.
support_reduction.sizes_six_and_seven: All color-preserving genbg classes with distinct nonzero right neighbourhoods are processed; duplicates from different choices of normalized base vertex are harmless.
